title: Innovatiview India IPO
summary: Innovatiview India IPO is a book-built issue of about ₹1,500 crore, proposed to be listed on BSE and NSE. The IPO dates, price band and lot size are yet to be announced.

b.p: Innovatiview India IPO has a total issue size of ₹1500 Crores Approx. and will be listed on BSE, NSE. Price band & Lot size details are yet to be announced.

kv: Dam Capital Advisors Ltd., ICICI Securities Ltd., JM Financial Ltd., Motilal Oswal Investment Advisors Ltd., Shannon Advisors Pvt.Ltd.

b.p: Data sourced from DRHP / RHP • For educational purposes only
Innovatiview India financials show revenue growth and profitability trends over recent years, indicating business stability.

Founded in October 2017 under the name Innovatiview India Limited, the company deals with automated security/surveillance solutions for examinations, elections, as well as mass events. As of September 30th, 2024, the company has a market share of 73.7%, the largest within the examination integrated security solution market for 2024. · · The company's offerings include delivering security and surveillance systems for elections and major events. In addition, it also offers information technology ('IT') equipment rental. The list of offerings includes comprehensive system integration solutions for a range of business verticals, majorly including building security, surveillance, and information systems.
Ashish Mittal, Ankit Agarwal, Vishal Mittal, Abhishek Agarwal are the company's promoters of Innovatiview India.
